first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. No target-specific determined-boundary/title-plan/register package is present in the verified lineage. Local OpenCode must retrieve and spatially bind the target-specific title/register/plan context before any canonical parcel bbox is asserted; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry title-plan guidance is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from INSPIRE semantics to title-plan/general-boundary semantics. It confirms that ordinary title plans identify general extent and normally use general boundaries rather than exact legal-boundary coordinates. Therefore this producer cannot promote a generic title-plan extent to canonical parcel geometry without target-specific register/plan context and, where precision is required, determined-boundary evidence. Spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
